name: golf-gps-app
description: Golf GPS app with course data and scoring features

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=frontend & npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace=backend
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npm run deploy:prod --workspace=backend
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=backend && npm run check --workspace=frontend
